==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I parkour my way out of a garden. I run up a ramp over a fence. I leap off the ramp high into the air and onto the second floor of a building.

I encounter a group of kids who seem to be possessed. I take some item away from the kids that has a supernatural energy around it. This enrages the kids and foils their mysterious plan.

I return to the garden. I am confronted by two young men with bamboo bo staffs. They attack me, I feel overwhelmed, but ultimately I somehow escaped before I wake up.
